title: Gitmap spot colour record (one line of spot-colors.ndjson)
description: A print separation (named ink): {name, cmyk}. Not a palette colour: no symbol draws in one, it has no stacking position, and OCAD and Mapper disagree on whether a separation also appears in the palette.

name.description: Separation name; its identity. Unique within the file.

cmyk.description: Ink [c, m, y, k], each 0..1, snapped to whole percent (2 dp). Required: a separation is defined by its CMYK; no RGB is stored (an OMap writer derives it from CMYK).
